title: Digit load and cake choices
hook: Two stated cases: explore the descriptive choice rates under stated conditions.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the descriptive choice rates under stated conditions affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Gap, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the descriptive choice rates under stated conditions in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
